# How to manage your newsletters and email campaigns with the systeme.io MCP server

In this article, you will learn how to manage your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) newsletters and email campaigns using natural language through our native MCP server. By connecting an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude, you can create, update, and organize your newsletters seamlessly without leaving your chat window.

What you will need:

- A [systeme.io](http://systeme.io/) account
- An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol))](https://help.systeme.io/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d)
- An AI tool connected to your systeme.io account using MCP keys:
  - [How to connect your systeme.io account with Claude using MCP keys](https://help.systeme.io/article/11230-how-to-connect-your-systemeio-account-with-claude-using-mcp-keys)
  - [How to connect your systeme.io account with ChatGPT using MCP keys](https://help.systeme.io/article/11229-how-to-connect-your-systemeio-account-with-chatgpt-using-mcp-keys)

Once your AI tool is connected to the [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) MCP server, you can manage your newsletters using simple, natural language prompts.

The MCP server allows you to perform basic actions on your newsletters directly from the chat. Just provide the required details and specify the action you want to perform.

**a. Create a newsletter:** You can ask the AI to generate a new newsletter draft in seconds. The integration supports creating newsletters using both the Classic Editor and the Visual Editor.

**Example:** Create a new newsletter in English about our upcoming Summer Sale using the visual editor. Mention that the sale starts on August 15, offers up to 40% off, and include a “Shop Now” button.

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/358b1cf5fe29b0f1a29d5595.png)![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/f03b685c4469155573c95e20.png)

**b. Update a newsletter:** If you need to change a newsletter's details, you can instruct the AI to easily update the subject line, preview text, or the email content itself.

**Example:** Update the subject line of the summer sale newsletter to "Don't miss our summer discounts!".

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/5f2e319f71fbef950b7c7114.png)![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/5adffd9f642a1d6e1dba1625.png)

**c. List and retrieve newsletters:** You can use the AI to browse your existing newsletters or fetch specific ones without manually searching your dashboard.

**Example:** List my 5 most recent newsletters.

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/5df96060694c3dbf211ab410.png)

Or find the newsletter with the subject line "Welcome to our community!".

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/d888853c2d834ecd4d526409.png)

**d. Advanced newsletter management:**
You can also instruct the AI to perform the following advanced actions on your newsletters without needing to provide further examples:

- **Target audiences:** Specify which contacts should receive the newsletter by including or excluding specific tags.
- **Configure sender details:** Update the sender name and sender email address for your newsletters.
- **Test and send:** Send a test email to yourself, or send the final newsletter directly to your audience.
- **Manage scheduling:** Schedule a newsletter for a later date, check its current scheduled date, or completely remove a schedule.
- **Delete drafts:** Delete any newsletter drafts you no longer need.
- **Email statistics:** Retrieve performance statistics for your newsletters, campaign emails, and automation emails. You can fetch totals for a specific period (up to 31 days) with a daily breakdown, results for each email sent during that period, or all-time results for a specific email. Statistics include sends, opens, clicks, bounces, and spam reports.

## 2. Managing email campaigns

The MCP server also allows you to build and manage your email campaigns and the individual emails (campaign steps) inside them directly from the chat.

a. **Create a campaign and campaign steps:** You can ask the AI to generate a brand-new email campaign and add individual emails (campaign steps) to it.

**Example**: Create the “Summer welcome sequence” campaign with a first email titled “Welcome to the summer club!” using the Classic Editor. Make it clean and simple: a welcome headline, 3–4 short friendly lines

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/daab88bb91b80a3eb61ebe1a.png)![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/f854cae9bb381acccbf40d55.png)

**b. Update a campaign or campaign step:** If you need to change a campaign's name or modify the subject line, preview text, or content of a specific campaign step, you can easily instruct the AI to make those updates.

**Example:** Update the first step of my "Summer welcome sequence" campaign to include a 10% discount code in the email content.

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/e3edb4ec905ad7fd141c874a.png)![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/9467637eb965369b88705822.png)

**c. List and retrieve campaigns:** You can use the AI to browse your existing email campaigns, view the specific steps inside them, or fetch a specific campaign by name.

**Example:** List all my existing email campaigns, and show me the steps inside the "Summer welcome cequence" campaign.

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/b6b9574acdaf7ae7ceb8e850.png)

**d. Delete a campaign or campaign step:** You can instruct the AI to delete entire campaigns or specific campaign steps that you no longer need.

**Example:** Delete the campaign step with the subject line "Welcome to the summer club!".

![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/2d0fd2f20a8962023a36a9c9.png)![](https://help.systeme.io/uploads/migrated/49b9818d26328e0ab6a66c20.png)

> **Notes:**
>
> - **Campaign scheduling:** Scheduling and activating campaign steps is not yet supported through MCP and must be managed manually from your systeme.io dashboard.
> - **Email statistics:** Retrieving per-recipient details and specific link-click statistics is not currently supported.
>
